en: Bonus Scenario 13: Secret Training
Huh...?

jp: なんで、あの二人がここに？
en: What are those two doing here?
...Haah, haah...
Done already?
Not yet!!
Hyaah!!
You have spirit... but--
Whoa!!
...You still have a long way to go.
Dammit~ I'm beaten, fair and square!

jp: 日々の鍛錬を怠らぬことだ
お前はまだ強くなれる
en: Do not neglect your daily training. You have talent. You can still grow stronger.

jp: だといいんだけどな・・
en: Here's hoping...

jp: ここまで連れてこられたのだが
en: ...You said you wanted to talk, and brought me all the way out here.

jp: お前の込み入った話とは
特訓に付き合えという意味だった
en: Was this "complicated matter" of yours just a request to spar with you?

jp: 手合わせ中に、隙あらば私を
殺そうとでも思っていたのか？
en: ..Or were you planning to kill me, if an opening presented itself mid-bout?

jp: だとしたら・・・どうする？
en: And if I was... what then?

jp: 今の腕では返り討ちだな
en: Heh. With your current skill, I would simply cut you down.
Says you... Well, the way I am now, I guess I can't argue...

jp: あんたみたいに強くなれるんだ？
en: Hey. How do I get as strong as you?

jp: まず、集中力が足りない
en: First, you lack focus.
Urk.

jp: それに、身長もそうだが
体重も増やした方がいいだろう
en: Also, your height aside, you would do well to put on some weight.

jp: それなんだけどさー・・・
何したらそんなに背が伸びるのか
en: Yeah, about that... What do I do to get that tall? Got any tips?
...Does it bother you?

jp: 無理に決まってるだろ？
en: Like it's even possible for it NOT to bother me!?

jp: 俺は絶対に、何が何でも
背が高くなりたいんだ！！！
en: I'm going to get taller, no matter what it takes!!

jp: 強くなりたいだけなら
背の高さにこだわる必要は
en: If all you want is strength, why fixate on height?

jp: 俺もいろいろと複雑なんだよ
en: It's complicated for me, okay.
Complicated?

jp: せめて目線の高さだけでも
対等でいたいってだけだよ
en: I just want to look the person I admire in the eye. At least that much, as an equal.

jp: ヴァルトスさんとの身長差を
en: Exal... So the height difference with Valtoss-san has been bothering him.

jp: それで嫌いなはずのミルクも
頑張って飲んでたんだ・・・
en: That's why he's been forcing down milk, even though he hates it...
Ah, oh no!

jp: ボクまだベイルを捜している
en: I was still in the middle of looking for Bale!

jp: 他のヤツらには言うなよ
en: Don't tell the others.

jp: 俺が背のこと気にしてるって
知ったら、あいつら絶対
からかってくるに決まってる！
en: If they knew my height bugged me, they'd never let me hear the end of it!

jp: 憧れの人と同じ目線か・・・
en: Eye to eye with the one you admire... A childish notion.

jp: ガキで悪かったな・・
en: Sorry for being a kid...

jp: 個人的な意見を言えば
小さいものは小さいままでも
やりようがあると思うぞ？
en: If you want my personal opinion, the small can manage perfectly well staying small.
Don't call me small!!!
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
